failure_modes.evidence: In summary_2, the solver claims 'Passage [4] confirms Max Gail starred in "D.C. Cab" (1983)' but Passage [4] only states 'Maxwell Trowbridge "Max" Gail Jr. (born April 5, 1943) is an American actor who has starred in stage, television, and film roles. He most notably portrayed the role of Detective Stan "Wojo" Wojciehowicz on the television sitcom "Barney Miller".' This passage does not mention D.C. Cab at all.

failure_modes.name: Entity_Coreference_Error
failure_modes.evidence: The claim states 'He also had a role in the TV series Carl Levitt' but Carl Levitt is a character name, not a TV series. The solver in summary_1 and summary_2 correctly identifies that 'Carl Levitt is a CHARACTER (an NYPD Police Officer), not a television series' and that Max Gail played a different character in 'Barney Miller.' However, the claim itself exhibits entity coreference confusion by treating a character name as if it were a series title.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: The query generated for hop 3 is 'Did Max Gail appear in or star in the 1983 film "D.C. Cab"? What was his role in that film?' This is a natural-language yes/no question format with a compound two-part ask, which may not be optimal for retrieval systems expecting keyword or entity-based queries.
